newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar reverses, ends little changed.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar reverses, ends little changed.

text.p: Nearby London white sugar futures shook off gloomy sentiment spilling over from the New York raws market and ended barely firmer on Friday evening.
The London futures rose in morning trade, but caught a chill and headed lower when funds baled out of the New York March raws contract.
But just before the European close, the spot December contract edged back into positive territory, finishing 10 cents higher at $318.30 per tonne after trading between $320.00 and $316.00.
March also ended 10 cents stronger at $315.50 after moving in a $4.00 range with a floor at $313.00.
In Paris, December closed down $1.00 at $317.50 and March off $2.10 at $314.00.
